# Camella Homes Philippines

> > The Philippines' leading real estate developer offering house and lot properties across Metro Manila, Mindanao, Cebu, and Laguna with investment insights and community guides.

Camella Homes provides residential properties throughout the Philippines, from Mega Manila to provincial cities like Digos City and Puerto Princesa. The site offers real estate investment guidance, property buying advice, community spotlights, and insights into Philippine infrastructure development and PPP projects.

- [Investment Appreciation: Why Increasing Real Estate Price is a Good Thing](https://www.camella.com.ph/investment-appreciation-why-increasing-real-estate-price-is-a-good-thing-2): Real estate price appreciation and inflation economics explained
- [What to Look for in an Airbnb Rental Home?](https://www.camella.com.ph/what-to-look-for-in-an-airbnb-rental-home): Guide for selecting Airbnb rental properties in the Philippines
- [Changes in Home Buying Before & During Pandemic](https://www.camella.com.ph/home-buying-before-and-during-pandemic): COVID-19 pandemic impact on Philippine home buying trends and preferences
